description: v2.1.0 section 10 — a first-class typed relation between two entity/event types, used by COMPOSE (section 9.2) to require more than naive Boolean conjunction between components.

left_type.description: Name of the type on the relation's left side, e.g. 'actor', 'event'. Not restricted to a closed enum — the type vocabulary is expected to grow with the offense corpus; the type checker (step 2) is where real type-safety is enforced, not this structural schema.

evaluation.description: structural (section 10.1, e.g. same_actor/temporal_order) -> resolved by the symbolic runtime from entity/event binding. evaluative (section 10.2, e.g. causal_nexus/foreseeability) -> routed to neural LegalElementAssessment, i.e. this field is what decides neural workload for the relation.
